# Security policy

The canonical policy is published at <https://github.com/astilbahq/env/security/policy>.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are issued for the latest released `0.1.x` version of `@astilba/env`.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for `astilbahq/env`. If that route is unavailable, contact the maintainers through the repository's security contact.

Do not include secrets, access tokens, private configuration values, customer data, or reproducible production endpoints in a public issue.

Include the affected version, a minimal reproduction, the impact, and any mitigation you have identified. Maintainers will acknowledge a valid report, investigate privately, and coordinate a fix before public disclosure.
